confidence_notes: I ran three web searches: one for the RBA rate and two for Jeonju prices. The RBA search found the 18 November 2026 observation of 0.6720 US dollars per Australian dollar, which I took from the search summary and did not open the RBA page. Restaurant meals and coffee come from cost-of-living aggregators (inexpensive meal about $6, mid-range dinner for two about $21-28, cappuccino about $3.3-3.7). Beer is based on a pub beer of roughly 4,500-6,000 KRW. Cocktail and wine are weakly sourced. Jeonju searches gave no cocktail price and one unverified wine price of about $8 at a high-end venue. I set cocktail and wine as multiples of beer, informed by Korean bar menus. I did not search for accommodation. Those anchors are holistic estimates from general knowledge of Korean hanok, hostel and business-hotel pricing, and I did not inspect any listings. They are the least certain anchors.
comparable_city_reasoning: Comparable to other mid-sized South Korean provincial cities such as Gwangju and Daegu. Prices are somewhat below Seoul, and Jeonju has steady domestic tourism around Hanok Village.
